plugins.name: memgit
plugins.description: One memory for Claude Code across sessions, machines and tools: versioned, searchable, with rollback. Installs itself (needs Node and Python 3.11+); memory arrives at session start and is saved as you work. Optional end-to-end encrypted sync.
plugins.install: pip install memgit && memgit init && memgit setup claude-code

description: memgit: one versioned memory for AI coding agents, across sessions, machines and tools
